verdict.rationale: Pendo documents an official MCP server that gives AI workflows access to usage data, and Leo can build guides and segments in conversation. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent creating or configuring a dashboard through the API or MCP. Read access to data and building guides or segments are adjacent capabilities, not dashboard construction, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent build a dashboard of my key metrics end-to-end via the API or MCP server
